insight: The client finds it easier to see the appeal of the newer hybrid offering (the visible saxophone element) than to articulate the value of the traditional band offering, and floated a rebrand walkthrough to revisit differentiation.
strategic_use: Use as discovery input for positioning conversations with multi-offer clients and for the buyer survey so couples explain what attracted them to each offering.
research_questions: What differentiators did the rebrand establish for each offering?
Do survey responses show buyers weigh the offerings differently from the owner's view?

insight: Fallon described past agency arrangements in other industries with much higher retainers and minimum ad spend, bigger creative volumes, custom copy and funnels, weekly reporting, and heavier team pressure, and linked burnout to client expectations and leadership culture.
strategic_use: Internal service-positioning and capacity context only. It is one person's recollection from other industries and not a wedding-industry benchmark or public claim about WIA.

insight: A learner found the course material digestible but wanted help knowing what to do when an ad goes wrong, and wanted downloadable references and more interactive learning. Carmen recognized resources serve normal tasks better than troubleshooting.
strategic_use: Product and education feedback for designing troubleshooting guides, reference materials and interactive support. It is one client's feedback.
research_questions: How common is the troubleshooting gap among other learners?
Which materials can be made downloadable?

insight: WIA is treating a move away from full-service ad management as a supported handoff. Whitney proposed a check-in around the next billing cycle, an offboarding call, selected video links without full community access, and recurring versus as-needed consulting calls with specific team members. One client's end date was tentative, and the other client was referenced by two names.
strategic_use: Internal service-design and retention insight about consultative alternatives. It is planned and the details and pricing were not settled, so treat it as internal only.
research_questions: Did either client move to consultative support and under what arrangement?
Do the two references to one client refer to the same person?

insight: The team lacks a systematic way to see which participants are in each program, their stage and whether ads were launched, so Whitney proposed weekly tagged posts and Gisselle proposed pipeline and card fields.
strategic_use: Internal program-support operations. Proposed, not shown to be working.
research_questions: Were the pipeline fields and weekly posts implemented and did they change participant activity?

insight: The coach flagged that the first market research survey question may not clearly define buyer types, so Whitney planned to revise it, re-ask previous recipients including nonresponders, and explore an in-email one-question survey via GHL.
strategic_use: Internal research-quality improvement, which also informs any public discussion of buyer surveys.
research_questions: What were the original and revised buyer-type question and answer choices?
What ambiguity did the coach identify?
Could the email survey be built in GHL?

insight: Whitney was skeptical of an email deliverability add-on because of its price, lack of social presence and reviews, and the possibility that a revenue-based opt-in answer changed the quote, and asked Gisselle to test with LeadLock's lower revenue. A client's deliverability concern prompted the search.
strategic_use: Audience intelligence on credibility and pricing barriers when evaluating tools. No capability or alternate quote was established.
research_questions: Does the price differ when the opt-in uses LeadLock's lower revenue, and what capabilities and terms are included?

insight: During a live check, a Google tag appeared installed on a WordPress site but a preview test failed to connect. Carmen worried about wasted Google Ads spend, and Fallon described an easier Wix installation. The cause was not found.
strategic_use: Internal troubleshooting and measurement-verification knowledge. It is unresolved and should not become public until a verified fix exists.
research_questions: Was the tag ultimately verified on the WordPress site and what resolved the mismatch between installation and preview?
